The test in tests/test_a_queued_launch_ignores_the_coordinator_backlog.py asserting that a direct dispatch raises UnreconciledRuns is changed to assert the recorded backlog, and that file is granted. Negative control: reinstating the refusal makes the direct-dispatch case raise. The test files importing reckon.crew.dispatch add no failure against the base revision, measured on all_debug , one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/dispatch.py , reckon/crew/queue_admission.py , the §7 test named above and the new test.
